description: This file declares a utility class 'string_utils' within the 'beerocks' namespace, providing static methods for string trimming, substring extraction, case-insensitive comparison, hex conversion, and other string manipulations.

classes.name: string_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static string manipulation methods.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace and additional characters from the start of a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace and additional characters from the end of a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace and additional characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: ltrimmed_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring trimmed from the start.

methods.name: rtrimmed_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring trimmed from the end.

methods.name: trimmed_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring trimmed from both ends.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only whitespace characters.

methods.name: bool_str
methods.description: Converts a boolean to its string representation ('true' or 'false').

methods.name: str_split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a delimiter.

methods.name: case_insensitive_compare
methods.description: Compares two strings ignoring case differences.

methods.name: endswith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: stoi
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit integer, with optional file and line info.

methods.name: T hex_to_bytes(const std::string & hex_data)
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a vector or string of bytes.

methods.name: int_to_hex_string
methods.description: Converts an integer to a hex string with a specified number of digits.

methods.name: bytes_string_to_string
methods.description: Converts a hex-encoded bytes string to a human-readable string.

methods.name: copy_string
methods.description: Copies a source string into a destination buffer with a specified length.

ctags.name: hex_to_bytes
ctags.pattern: /^    template <class T> static T hex_to_bytes(const std::string &hex_data)$/
